subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should this protected, stale macOS onboarding PR be closed as superseded by the merged current-main setup work, or should the contributor be asked for a narrow rebase that preserves any unique remaining pieces?
rationale: The `maintainer` label blocks automatic cleanup even though current main covers the central setup flow and the PR still has security/auth findings; only maintainers should decide whether to close or sponsor a rebase.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this PR after maintainer confirmation because current main already owns the local Gateway setup and onboarding direction through the merged replacement PRs.

options.title: Request a narrow rebase
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase onto current main, drop superseded code, fix the listed security/auth findings, and attach real macOS behavior proof.

options.title: Adopt manually
options.body: A maintainer can cherry-pick any small unique UI copy or test ideas into a fresh branch if they still matter after the current-main onboarding rewrite.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR after maintainer confirmation because current main already owns the local Gateway setup and onboarding direction through the merged replacement PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the merged macOS Gateway bootstrap and Crestodian onboarding work that now defines the overlapping product direction.
